admission.goal: A caller-supplied filter string is accepted by `pcap_compile()` and turned into a non-null optimizer input graph.

root.goal: An optimizer allocation-failure path leaves a previously freed `opt_state->blocks` pointer stored in `opt_state` before unwinding.

target.goal: Cleanup later frees the same `opt_state->blocks` pointer again during optimizer error unwinding.
target.predicate: cleanup_blocks.hit && cleanup_blocks.blocks_ptr == root.dangling_blocks.blocks_ptr && cleanup_blocks.blocks_ptr != 0 && cleanup_blocks.time > root.dangling_blocks.time
